  LEFT JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id

  GROUP BY o.order_id
)

       AVG(pay_total) AS avg_payment_value,
       AVG(item_total) AS avg_item_value,
       AVG(item_total) FILTER (WHERE item_total IS NOT NULL) AS avg_item_value_nonnull
FROM order_totals
